date.as_written: nidhyagnāśvidhau 1739 śake vrajaṃ dine śukrākhya māse tithau dvādaśyāṃ

place.as_written: nagare da . . . la vana(?) śrīvarddhamānābhidhe || ... vākā nāma nadītaṭe tu viṣaye śrīmaṅgalāsannidhau

notes: The scribe is either named Bhūdeva or referred to generally as a brāhmaṇa (bhūdeva); the verb appears to be samalīlikhat ('wrote/copied'). The month 'śukrākhya' refers to Jyeṣṭha.
